lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-torso and becomes more compressed in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 8th line (posterior-most) is an abbreviated segment that terminates before reaching the dorsal or ventral margins.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: 3 distinct white spots are located on the upper haunch/hind limb area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial posterior-lateral sweep from the skull followed by a medial-anterior turn towards the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The 2D distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.5 times the total width across the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips account for approximately 12 percent of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker on the dorsal-midline; distinct white chevron between the orbits; two white spots on the lower malar region; prominent dark ventral mane.
